evidence: SOURCE: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template tests/Dockerfile and to the live project copy (sha256 72998ab8ef0e4225e63b88fccdb754943c54022e25da355035efe7f759a55fdd for all three; preflight canonical:tests/Dockerfile passed). It ships every component the row and quality-checks.md #22 name: Node runtime (line 4 `COPY --from=node-runtime /usr/local /usr/local` from node:22-bookworm-slim, NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules line 9); judge CLI `@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281` (line 17); Playwright MCP `@playwright/mcp@0.0.79` (line 19); app runtime deps `express@5.1.0` and `better-sqlite3@12.4.1` (lines 20-21), which exactly match the agent image environment/Dockerfile lines 10-11, solution/app/package.json dependencies, and integration.md 'use only those packages and Node built-ins'; pinned RewardKit `harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7` (line 31); Chromium installed by the Playwright CLI bundled with the pinned MCP package and symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium (lines 33-38), which is exactly the `--executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium` used by every judge.toml playwright-mcp server (e.g. scored/functional/judge.toml lines 11-12); python3 from the python:3.12-slim base for restart_mcp.py (functional judge.toml lines 17-18 `/usr/local/bin/python3`); util-linux (line 13) supplies setpriv/setsid used by test.sh lines 99-111; procps for process handling. `COPY . /tests` (line 43) makes the image self-contained. Base images are tag-pinned (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim) and apt is unpinned (a NOTE per check-dockerfiles.py); both are template-controlled and not task defects. RUNTIME (current bytes): raw-evidence-index entries re-hashed and match; workspace.cjs line 6 loads Playwright from /usr/local/lib/node_modules/@playwright/mcp/node_modules/playwright and line 227 launches executablePath '/usr/local/bin/chromium' with --no-sandbox inside image hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair against the frozen solution bytes as uid 65534 with a real restart; results/workspace.json records passing groups including restart, and server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000' twice (initial and restart). This shows the image's Node + global express/better-sqlite3 start the golden and its Chromium/Playwright drive it. RUNTIME (historical, identical layers): build-verifier.log for that same image tag shows Dockerfile steps verbatim identical to the current file (npm -g list, rewardkit==0.1.7, chromium install, codex patch); configured-inspection.log records `claude --version` -> 2.1.281, `playwright-mcp --version` -> Version 0.0.79 (so the `playwright-mcp` command named in judge.toml resolves on PATH), `node --version` -> v22.23.2, and RewardKit parsing/argument launch exit 0 with NO provider grade. Counterexample attempts: (a) a broken app that needs a package absent from the verifier (e.g. global `ws`) would fail to start and score 0, but the brief forbids extra packages and vendoring in /app/node_modules is copied with /app, so this is not a harness-attributed failure; (b) a conforming app using only express, better-sqlite3 and Node built-ins (including SSE or polling for live updates) has every runtime it needs in this image; no conforming alternative found that the image could not launch. RISK: the row says 'can launch and grade', and no full configured verifier run (test.sh -> rewardkit -> claude-code judge with the frozen [verifier.env] provider) has been measured on the current input; the raw-evidence-index scope itself states 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent', and REVIEW_POLICY requires a hash-bound 'full verifier launch/grading' runtime record before clearance. The tool-presence evidence for claude/playwright-mcp/rewardkit comes from an earlier candidate's build (identical layers, earlier /tests contents), not a build of the current tests/ bytes. Source-level Pass; grading launch remains an evidence gap.
